# ♿ Accessibility Review

## Page and environment
Route/entry point, browser and assistive technology.

## Checklist
- [ ] Keyboard-only operation
- [ ] Visible focus
- [ ] Labels and instructions
- [ ] Error announcement
- [ ] Semantic headings and landmarks
- [ ] Contrast and non-color cues
- [ ] Zoom/reflow
- [ ] Reduced motion
- [ ] Accessible data tables/results

## Findings
Describe barriers and severity.

## Retest
Commit, browser, assistive technology and outcome.
